name: wx-vsce-diesel-schema
description: Diesel `schema.rs` analyzer — outline view of tables and columns, hover with full column lists, completion of table names and FK columns inside `diesel::joinable!` / `diesel::allow_tables_to_appear_in_same_query!`, and diagnostics for unknown table/column references. Powered by a Rust analyzer compiled to WebAssembly.

dieselSchema.enabled.description: Enable the diesel schema analyzer for Rust files containing `diesel::table!` invocations.

dieselSchema.diagnostics.enabled.description: Emit diagnostics for unknown table/column references, duplicates, and joinable/allow-group mismatches.

dieselSchema.diagnostics.onType.description: Recompute diagnostics as you type (debounced). Turn off to only recompute on save.

dieselSchema.completion.enabled.description: Suggest table names inside `diesel::joinable!` / `diesel::allow_tables_to_appear_in_same_query!`, and FK column names for the child table.

scripts.package: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
